_comment: Open-finance TPP clients onboarded by the realm import Job's last step (scripts/realm/onboard-tpp.mjs --tpps, bootstrap admin credential), after keycloak-config-cli and the admin-permissions step. Identity owns TPP onboarding; consent-authorization (or the TPP onboarding desk) asks for a TPP by pull request adding one spec here. A spec names the TPP only: clientId (of-tpp-<kebab>), name, redirectUris (https), jwksUri or a public jwks, paymentServices {authorised, reference}, status active|suspended (default active; suspended disables the client and revokes its sessions, an operator-disabled active client is left disabled and flagged; suspend and off-board procedure in docs/identity/REALM_AS_CODE.md). Scopes and attributes come from the realm template of-tpp-conformance-template and cannot be set here. Empty until the first TPP is approved (Proposed).
